purpose: Verify doctor availability combines master schedule and current-day real-time attendance
preconditions: Doctor schedule is published and attendance recorded for current date
action_or_input: Query doctor availability view
expected_result: Result contains master schedule and current-day attendance status together

purpose: Verify patient can access their own medical records read-only
preconditions: Patient has recorded visits and prescriptions
action_or_input: Patient requests own medical history
expected_result: Patient own records returned in read-only form

purpose: Verify patient accessing another patient medical record is strictly prohibited
preconditions: Patient A attempts to access Patient B record
action_or_input: Patient A requests Patient B record by ID
expected_result: Access denied with UnauthorizedRecordAccessError or 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify authorized role permitted to perform assigned PHC function
preconditions: User has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff adjusts inventory stock
expected_result: Operation authorized and succeeds

purpose: Verify unauthorized role denied from performing restricted PHC function
preconditions: User is authenticated as student
action_or_input: Student attempts to post inventory stock adjustment
expected_result: Access denied with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify employee is eligible to submit reimbursement claim
preconditions: User has Employee (faculty or staff) role
action_or_input: Evaluate employee claimant eligibility
expected_result: Claimant is evaluated as eligible

purpose: Verify student is strictly prohibited from submitting reimbursement claim
preconditions: User has Student role
action_or_input: Student submits reimbursement claim
expected_result: Submission rejected with IneligibleClaimantError

purpose: Verify reimbursement claim with valid prescription belonging to claimant is accepted
preconditions: Valid recorded prescription exists for claimant
action_or_input: Employee submits claim linked to their own prescription
expected_result: Claim is accepted and enters reimbursement processing

purpose: Verify reimbursement claim missing valid claimant prescription is rejected
preconditions: Prescription does not exist or belongs to another patient
action_or_input: Employee submits claim with invalid prescription reference
expected_result: Submission rejected with PrescriptionRequiredError

purpose: Verify reimbursement claim with expense date within 90-day window is accepted
preconditions: Expense date is within 90 days of submission
action_or_input: Employee submits claim for expense incurred 30 days ago
expected_result: Submission window validation succeeds and claim is created

purpose: Verify reimbursement claim with expense date exceeding 90-day window is rejected
preconditions: Expense date is 91 or more days prior to submission
action_or_input: Employee submits claim for expense incurred 100 days ago
expected_result: Submission rejected with SubmissionWindowExpiredError

purpose: Verify low-stock warning generated when stock level falls strictly below threshold
preconditions: Item has reorder threshold 20 and initial stock 25
action_or_input: Stock is deducted by 10 resulting in stock 15 (< 20)
expected_result: Low-stock alert notification created for PHC Staff

purpose: Verify no low-stock alert generated when stock level remains at or above threshold
preconditions: Item has reorder threshold 20 and initial stock 30
action_or_input: Stock is deducted by 10 resulting in stock 20 (== 20)
expected_result: No low-stock alert notification created

purpose: Verify accepted claim follows exact forward progression across mandatory stages
preconditions: Claim is submitted by employee
action_or_input: Claim advances through PHC Review -> Accounts Verify -> Sanction -> Payment
expected_result: Stages advance strictly in order: Pending PHC Review -> Pending Accounts Verification -> Pending Sanction -> Approved for Payment -> Reimbursed

purpose: Verify Approving Authority rejection terminates reimbursement claim
preconditions: Claim is Pending Sanction
action_or_input: Approving Authority rejects claim sanction
expected_result: Claim status becomes Rejected and progression terminates

purpose: Verify immutable audit trail recorded when patient record is created
preconditions: User is authorized PHC Staff
action_or_input: Staff creates patient visit and digitized prescription
expected_result: PHCAuditTrail entries created with target_type PATIENT_RECORD

purpose: Verify immutable audit trail recorded when inventory stock level is adjusted
preconditions: User is authorized PHC Staff
action_or_input: Staff performs stock addition or deduction
expected_result: PHCAuditTrail entry created with target_type INVENTORY_LEVEL

purpose: Verify immutable audit trail recorded when reimbursement claim status changes
preconditions: User submits or transitions claim
action_or_input: Claim is submitted and transitioned
expected_result: PHCAuditTrail entry created with target_type REIMBURSEMENT_CLAIM

purpose: Verify approved inventory requisition proceeds to delivery fulfillment
preconditions: Requisition status is Approved
action_or_input: Staff marks requisition as Fulfilled
expected_result: Requisition status updated to Fulfilled

purpose: Verify fulfillment prohibited when requisition is not Approved
preconditions: Requisition status is Pending Approval or Rejected
action_or_input: Staff attempts to fulfill unapproved requisition
expected_result: Fulfillment rejected with RequisitionNotApprovedError

purpose: Verify originator notified when inventory requisition is decided
preconditions: Requisition submitted by PHC Staff originator
action_or_input: Approver approves or rejects requisition
expected_result: Decision notification created for requisition originator

purpose: Verify administrative reports protect PII and anonymize patient data
preconditions: Clinical visit and patient data exist
action_or_input: Generate demographics report
expected_result: Report output has anonymized=True with no individual patient identifiers

purpose: Verify claimant notified on claim status changes including rejection and payment
preconditions: Claim transitions to rejected or paid
action_or_input: Claim status changes
expected_result: Status notification generated for the claimant

purpose: Verify in-place modification or reopening of submitted or rejected claim is prohibited
preconditions: Claim is in submitted or rejected state
action_or_input: Attempt to edit or reopen existing claim
expected_result: Action blocked with ClaimImmutableError; new claim required
